Inside a mountain in the Femor Hills there is a two-floor goblin lair. At the bottom, next to the beer barrels, are the quest boxes with a {item:Power Ring} and a {item:Bronze Amulet}. A good quest for low levels.
Magic Carpet in the Femor Hills
No Premium or minimum level required (15 recommended).
On the last two floors, all the goblins (and wolves) attack you as soon as you enter the room. Go in with full health and potions at hand.

The {wiki:Femor Hills} are **north** of Kazordoon, **east** of Carlin and southwest of Ab'Dendriel: you can walk there from any of these cities. With Premium, take a {wiki:Magic Carpet} (Darashia, Edron, Farmine, Svargrond, Kazordoon or Issavi) and tell the pilot {key:hi}, {key:femor hills} (or just {key:hills}) and {key:yes}. The carpet arrives at the top of a hill in the **southwest** of the Femor Hills (3 floors above the ground), where {npc:Uzon} is: go down to ground level and head **northeast**, to the river.
The carpet only works with Premium. Without Premium, walk from Kazordoon (north) or from Carlin (east).
Follow the river and climb up with the rope
In the **Femor Hills**, follow the **south** bank of the river that goes into the mountain (just north of the {wiki:Magic Carpet}). Use the {item:Rope} to go up one floor.
Magic Carpet (the river is right to the north)
Go down the stairs to the north
Go **east**, into the mountain, and go down the stairs to the **north**.
Path to the stairs inside the mountain
Follow the path **northeast** and go down the hole.

Here there are up to 11 {creature:Goblin|Goblins} and 4 {creature:Wolf|Wolves}, who attack you as soon as you enter, and {item:Fire Field|fire fields} scattered around the room. Go **southwest** and go down one more floor.
Room with goblins, wolves and fire: go down to the southwest
Up to 11 more {creature:Goblin|Goblins}, who also all attack you when you enter. To the **south** there is a pen with up to 5 {creature:Pig|Pigs}.
Last floor: the quest boxes are in the north, next to the barrels
The quest boxes are on the **north** side of this room, next to the {item:Beer Cask|beer casks}. Open them to get the {item:Power Ring} and the {item:Bronze Amulet}.

Go back the same way: go up the two places where you went down (use the {item:Rope} on the holes), go up the stairs, leave the mountain to the **west** and go back down to the riverbank. From there you walk back to Kazordoon, Carlin or Ab'Dendriel, or take the carpet of {npc:Uzon} (Premium): {key:hi}, the name of the city and {key:yes}.
